scope: Existing official-training labels only; no image, feature, model, tensor or retrieval execution
split_rule: Partition sorted identities by whether they have >=2 distinct scene labels; round-robin each sorted group into folds 0/1/2. Label-only deterministic rule; no random draw, feature ranking, hard-identity selection or split scan.
split_rule_source: tools/build_v8_oof_router_targets.py:19-39 supplies the existing stratified round-robin pattern; this protocol uses MSVR310 scene eligibility.

evaluation.gallery: Every record of every heldout identity in its own fold
evaluation.query: Heldout records with at least one same-identity different-scene gallery record
evaluation.retain: All different-identity gallery records, including same-scene negatives and single-scene identities
evaluation.aggregation: Pool per-query AP/Rank results after fold-local distances; never compare features across folds
evaluation.separate_development_split: None registered in this data protocol
evaluation.checkpoint_selection: Future training contract must use fixed source-only endpoints
evaluation.official_query_and_gallery: Not used to construct folds, source labels, query masks or scores
